metadata.value: This project attempts to embed a story into a music playlist by sorting the playlist (i.e., sequencing it) so that the order of the music follows a narrative arc. The music tracks are fitted to a fixed narrative template based on the output of a machine learning model, which itself distills each track down to its narrative essence.
